title: Fin and the Glowing Sea
subtitle: An underwater tale with a twist
author: Storylight
blurb: An underwater tale that reads itself aloud, lights up every word, and glows when you touch it.

magic.jar: An empty jar, to fill with light.
magic.pearl: A pearl, bright as the moon, into the jar it went.
magic.song: The whale's song carried everyone up, up, up.
magic.laugh: The lantern fish laughed, and her light came back!

openai.instructions: You are a warm, gentle storyteller reading a picture book to a young child at bedtime. Read slowly and clearly, with hushed underwater wonder. Pause briefly at full stops. Give the crab a quick clicky voice, the octopus a playful whisper, the whale a very low slow rumble, the lantern fish a small silvery voice, and Fin a soft, brave, curious voice. Never rush. Leave a little silence after the last word.

questions.q: Who is the main character of the story?
questions.right: Yes! Fin the little turtle is the main character.
questions.wrong: Not quite. The octopus and the crab are Fin's friends. The main character is Fin, the little sea turtle.

questions.q: What did Fin carry to collect the light?
questions.right: That's right! Fin carried a little glass jar, and her friends filled it with light.
questions.wrong: Hmm, not that one. Fin carried a little glass jar. Every friend put a bit of light inside.

questions.q: Who sang low and slow in the deep, deep sea?
questions.right: Yes! The big whale sang low and slow.
questions.wrong: Not quite. It was the big whale who sang, low and slow, down in the deep.

questions.q: Who gave Fin a ride up to the light?
questions.right: Yes! "Hop on, everyone!" rumbled the whale.
questions.wrong: Not quite. The octopus danced and the crab clapped. It was the whale who gave everyone a ride.

questions.q: What did Fin find in the old ship's chest?
questions.right: That's right! A pearl, bright as the moon.
questions.wrong: Hmm, not that one. In the old chest Fin found a pearl, bright as the moon.
